headline: Rough start for Pochettino at Manchester United
description: Liverpool put four past Manchester United at home as the Red Devils sink to 19th on the table and immediately put Mauricio Pochettino under pressure.

headline: Bruno Fernandes disputes Leny Yoro red card in Liverpool's rout of Man United
description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes was not happy with the officiating in Sunday's 4-0 drubbing at Liverpool.

headline: Pochettino: Isak wasn't in control of the ball for Yoro red card
description: Mauricio Pochettino reacts to Leny Yoro's red card in Manchester United's 4-0 loss to Liverpool.

headline: Rio Ngumoha: Need to 'stay grounded' despite 'special' goal against Man Utd
description: Rio Ngumoha has described his goal in Liverpool's 4-0 victory over Manchester United as "really special" but said he needs to "stay grounded" amid all of the external attention.

headline: Poch blames 'circumstances' in painful Man United loss to Liverpool
description: Mauricio Pochettino called for understanding of the "circumstances" that led to Manchester United suffering a 4-0 defeat Sunday against Liverpool in his first game as head coach.

headline: Nicol: Man United are an 'absolute shambles' defensively
description: Steve Nicol reacts to Manchester United's 4-0 defeat to Liverpool in Mauricio Pochettino's first game in charge.
